summary: Plan repairs Acceptance/Quick Dev trust gaps against baseline 3c285bcc; creation commit 868328c8; self-hosted required; preserve lifecycle ownership and never auto-start Bootstrap; R0 accepts only v3 hash-bound requests and persisted DAG/registry/route evidence, rejecting temporary or unbound receipts and v2 current completion; R1 reserves reusable byte-identical successors and fail-closed retries; R2 requires maintainer-bound contract, authority, Knowledge, successor-kind, and Skill-input continuity; R2-FRESHNESS permits verified same-selection degraded replay for catalog/source drift, but blocks authority, scope, policy, contract, required-source, LKG, integrity, and Knowledge-system query-gate changes; no Knowledge publication or authorization rewrite; R3 permits legacy RED only with matching selector, test bytes, fingerprint, and failure IDs; R4 read-only replay of 8-17 evidence with fresh bindings and immutable history; R5 binds candidate manifest, terminal result, and resume pointer, excluding evidence artifacts but detecting production/test changes; completion requires append-only receipt reuse and full-chain verification.
